description: This file defines the class 'ExistsThingPredicateVisitor', which implements 'ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor' for 'Predicate<Thing>' objects. It provides methods to create predicates that check for the existence of attributes, features, feature properties, and JSON fields within 'Thing' objects, used in a query context.

classes.name: ExistsThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that generates predicates for 'Thing' objects based on an 'ExistsFieldExpression'. It checks for the existence of various fields or features within 'Thing' instances.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: A static method that takes an 'ExistsFieldExpression' and returns a 'Predicate<Thing>' by accepting this visitor.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if an attribute with the specified key exists within a 'Thing'.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if a feature with the specified featureId exists within a 'Thing'.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if a specific property within a feature exists within a 'Thing'.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if a simple JSON field with the specified fieldName exists within a 'Thing'.
